newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Dec orders up.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Purchasing Mgrs say Dec orders up.

text.p: The Cincinnati chapter of the National Association of Purchasing Management said Tuesday in its December report that their indices showed the possible beginning of an increase in the rate of recovery.
New orders showed the second highest increase of the year and finished goods inventories showed the largest rate of decrease since the survey began in 1992, the group said.
"Commodity prices now show a three-month increasing trend and we would expect the index to continue to increase," the group said. It cautioned vendor deliveries may slow and some prices may increase.
